name: After recital 15
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council establishing the exchange, assistance and training programme for the protection of the euro against counterfeiting for the period 2028-2034 (the 'Pericles V' programme) and repealing Regulation (EU) 2021/840
part_text: (15b) In order to maintain a high and equivalent level of protection of the euro across the Union and to address current and emerging threats, including those related to technological developments and the possible introduction of a digital euro, it is necessary to continue supporting specialised training, information exchange, technical assistance and operational cooperation under the Programme.
